## 1. General Requirements

### 1.1 Basis of preparation
This section sets out the basis on which the sustainability-related financial disclosures in this report package have been prepared and presented.

The disclosures are prepared with reference to IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards requirements evidenced in internal governance documentation, including references to IFRS S2 paragraph-level considerations recorded in board materials (e.g., §6(a)(iii) and §6(a)(v)).

### 1.2 Statement of alignment with IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards
The organisation has indicated alignment with IFRS S2 in governance-related disclosures.

### 1.3 Governance evidence supporting preparation and oversight
The following internal evidence items support the preparation and oversight context for these disclosures:

- Board materials include references to IFRS S2 paragraph-level requirements (including §6(a)(iii) and §6(a)(v)).
- Governance records include multiple instances marked as IFRS S2 aligned.

> Connectivity note: Governance-related alignment and oversight context is addressed through governance disclosures within this report package. Refer to the Governance section for detailed roles, responsibilities, and processes.
